reply:
I've written the kvhttp server in AArch64 assembly, and `node check.mjs` passes all 4 example cases.

I also wrote two extra test scripts in `tests/`, and both pass:
- **`stress.mjs`** stores and reads back a 1 MiB binary value, an empty value, and a 64-character key. It runs 100 requests at once and checks the sorted key list after 500 inserts and 250 deletes. It also covers the 400, 404 and 405 errors.
- **`raw.mjs`** sends requests split into small pieces, a lowercase `content-length` header
